title: Grateful Dead Live at The Silver Dollar Fair on 1968-11-01
source: This is a restoration/rework using shnid 18100 (Cotsman) and 09580 (Axelrod); Diamond Cut Forensics versions 8.5 and Alpha 9 for the editing.

ai_review.summary: Great performance (favorite New Potato missing) but the recording suffers from severe cuts despite extra Alligator jam into Caution.
ai_review.review: Reviewers love the show – one calls it "awesome" aside from the absent New Potato – yet the tape is plagued by attenuated signal and dramatic splice artifacts that make large sections hard to enjoy. The restoration does preserve a few minutes of the Alligator > Caution jam not found elsewhere, offering a small redeeming bonus for collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: One glowing 5‑star review praises the performance while the other gives a 0‑star rating due to major recording flaws; the average lands around 2½–3, weighted toward show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Attenuated signal and heavily hacked‑up sections with dramatic cuts; some portions are listenable after restoration but overall the tape is uneven. Includes extra minutes of Alligator jam into Caution not present on other sources.
